scripts.gen-key: node -e "const crypto=require('crypto'); const k=crypto.generateKeyPairSync('ec',{namedCurve:'prime256v1'}); console.log('=== RELAY_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM ===\n' + k.privateKey.export({type:'pkcs8',format:'pem'})); console.log('=== PUBLIC_KEY_B64 ===\n' + k.publicKey.export({type:'spki',format:'der'}).toString('base64url'));"
